searchStrategy: simulated annealing over concrete inputs: one small typed value change per move, geometric cooling with restarts
skipReasons: ไม่มี class ที่ถูกข้าม (ไม่พบ class ใน classes.modified)
inputConstruction: typed scalar, enum, array, collection, map, optional, proxy, constructor and concrete-subclass samples; receiver construction variants and up to three set-up calls before the observed call
fitness: executed coverage probes of the modified classes, weighted by rarity (uncovered probes weigh most), plus branch distance to outcomes not yet taken, plus new outcome kinds
